modelOverview: Descended from the pioneering aviator's watch Louis Cartier created for Alberto Santos-Dumont in 1904, the modern Santos de Cartier was relaunched at SIHH 2018 with a squared, integrated-bracelet case, exposed bezel screws, and the QuickSwitch/SmartLink strap system for tool-free bracelet changes. The Large model measures 39.8mm and is powered throughout by Cartier's in-house automatic Calibre 1847 MC. It remains one of Cartier's most recognisable and versatile sports-luxury watches, offered across steel, two-tone, ADLC and precious-metal executions.

WSSA0018.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1847 MC · ~42h power reserve
WSSA0018.dial: Silvered opaline dial with black Roman numerals and steel sword-shaped hands
WSSA0018.description: The reference Santos de Cartier Large in steel, reintroduced as part of Cartier's 2018 relaunch of the model. It pairs a silvered opaline dial with the signature squared case, exposed bezel screws and the QuickSwitch/SmartLink system that allows the steel bracelet and calfskin strap to be swapped without tools. Sourced and authenticated for the Hatton Garden market.
